subject: English
stimulus: (a) Walk fast lest ⎯⎯. (b) It is high time ⎯⎯. (c) The man was so weak ⎯⎯. (d) A stitch in time ⎯⎯. (e) As he was meritorious ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Walk fast lest you should miss the bus. (b) It is high time we took steps against corruption. (c) The man was so weak that he could not talk. (d) A stitch in time saves nine. (e) As he was meritorious, he could understand the matter easily.
